blocks.p: Welcome to EDDVA, an Artificial Intelligence-powered digital transformation platform for schools and institutions developed and operated by Veteran Ventures & Services Pvt. Ltd. ("VVSPL", "we", "our", or "us"). At VVSPL, we recognise that privacy and data security are fundamental to building trust with educational institutions, students, parents, teachers, and all users of our Platform. We are committed to protecting the Personal Data entrusted to us and ensuring that it is processed responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. This Privacy Policy explains how VVSPL collects, receives, stores, uses, processes, discloses, shares, retains, and protects Personal Data when you access or use EDDVA through our website, web application, mobile applications, or any other services offered under the EDDVA ecosystem. This Privacy Policy has been prepared in accordance with the provisions of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011, and other applicable laws and regulations of India. By accessing or using EDDVA, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and consent to the processing of your Personal Data in accordance with its terms.

This Privacy Policy applies to all users of EDDVA, including students, parents or legal guardians, teachers, faculty members, school or institutional administrators, educational institutions, coaching centres, colleges, universities, visitors to our website, and any individual or organisation using or interacting with the Platform. This Privacy Policy governs the processing of Personal Data collected through EDDVA, including our website, web portal, Android application, iOS application, APIs, cloud infrastructure, customer support services, communication channels, and any other services provided by VVSPL under the EDDVA ecosystem. This Privacy Policy does not apply to third-party websites, applications, or services that may be linked to or integrated with EDDVA. Such third-party services are governed by their respective privacy policies, and VVSPL shall not be responsible for their privacy practices.

VVSPL collects only such Personal Data as is reasonably necessary to provide educational services, maintain the security and integrity of the Platform, comply with legal obligations, and improve the overall user experience. Depending upon the services used, we may collect Personal Data including your name, email address, mobile number, date of birth, gender, profile photograph, institution name, student or employee identification number, admission or roll number, class, section, department, designation, parent or guardian details, emergency contact information, and any other information voluntarily provided during registration or while using the Platform. EDDVA also processes academic information including attendance records, assignments, assessments, examinations, report cards, grades, learning progress, academic performance, rankings, certifications, study plans, AI-generated recommendations, teacher remarks, and other educational records necessary for delivering educational services. In addition, we automatically collect certain technical information such as IP address, browser type, operating system, device information, application version, network information, login history, session logs, cookies, crash reports, diagnostic information, and usage analytics to ensure platform security, reliability, and continuous improvement. Where educational institutions enable specific features, EDDVA may request permission to access device hardware including the camera, microphone, storage, and notifications for purposes such as live classes, attendance verification, online examinations, AI-assisted proctoring, assignment submissions, document uploads, and communication services. Such permissions are requested only through the device operating system and may be managed by the user through device settings. Where online payment facilities are enabled, limited transaction-related information may be processed to facilitate payments through authorised payment gateway providers. VVSPL does not store debit card numbers, credit card details, CVV numbers, UPI PINs, internet banking credentials, or other payment authentication information on its servers.

Personal Data may be collected directly from you when you create an account, register on the Platform, enrol in courses, participate in live or recorded classes, attempt assessments, submit assignments, communicate with teachers or institutions, contact customer support, participate in surveys, provide feedback, or otherwise interact with EDDVA. We may also receive Personal Data from educational institutions that subscribe to EDDVA and authorise the creation of user accounts for students, teachers, administrators, or parents. Certain technical information is collected automatically through cookies, server logs, analytics tools, and similar technologies whenever you access or use the Platform.

sections.heading: 5. How We Use Your Personal Data

blocks.p: VVSPL processes Personal Data solely for lawful educational and operational purposes. The information collected enables us to provide and improve EDDVA, authenticate users, manage accounts, deliver educational content, conduct assessments, generate AI-powered educational resources, monitor attendance, facilitate communication between institutions, teachers, students, and parents, provide customer support, maintain platform security, comply with legal obligations, and improve the quality, functionality, and performance of our services. Where AI-powered features are enabled, Personal Data may be processed to generate study notes, lecture transcripts, personalised learning recommendations, quizzes, study plans, performance analytics, and other educational insights designed to improve learning outcomes and support educators. VVSPL does not use student or institutional data for advertising, behavioural profiling, or any unrelated commercial purpose.

EDDVA incorporates Artificial Intelligence technologies to enhance the educational experience and support personalised learning. AI-powered features may include automated note generation, lecture transcription, quiz generation, study planners, learning recommendations, academic analytics, doubt assistance, and content summarisation. The AI services provided through EDDVA are intended solely to assist students, teachers, and educational institutions in teaching, learning, and academic administration. AI-generated content should be considered as educational assistance and does not replace professional academic judgement, teacher evaluation, or institutional decision-making. VVSPL continuously monitors and improves its AI systems to enhance accuracy, relevance, and educational effectiveness. However, AI-generated outputs may occasionally contain inaccuracies, and users are encouraged to exercise appropriate academic judgement before relying upon such outputs.

VVSPL respects the confidentiality of Personal Data and does not sell, rent, lease, or commercially exploit Personal Data collected through EDDVA. Personal Data may be shared only where necessary for providing the services offered through the Platform. This may include sharing information with the concerned educational institution, authorised teachers, parents or legal guardians, trusted cloud infrastructure providers, payment gateway providers, communication service providers, technical support partners, and other service providers engaged by VVSPL for the operation and maintenance of EDDVA. Personal Data may also be disclosed where required by applicable law, judicial order, governmental authority, law enforcement agency, or regulatory body having lawful jurisdiction. All third-party service providers engaged by VVSPL are required to maintain appropriate confidentiality, implement reasonable security safeguards, and process Personal Data only for the purposes authorised by VVSPL and in accordance with applicable laws.

VVSPL is committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the Personal Data processed through EDDVA. We implement appropriate administrative, technical, and organisational measures designed to safeguard Personal Data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised access, disclosure, misuse, or any other form of unlawful processing. Our security measures include secure cloud infrastructure, encrypted communication channels, role-based access controls, authentication mechanisms, activity logging, regular system monitoring, vulnerability assessments, data backup procedures, disaster recovery planning, and periodic security reviews. Access to Personal Data is restricted to authorised personnel who require such access for legitimate business or operational purposes and who are bound by confidentiality obligations. While VVSPL employs industry-recognised security practices to protect Personal Data, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure. Accordingly, we cannot guarantee absolute security, and users are encouraged to protect their account credentials and promptly notify us of any suspected unauthorised access or security incident.

VVSPL retains Personal Data only for as long as it is necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, provide the services requested by users and educational institutions, comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations, resolve disputes, enforce contractual rights, and maintain legitimate business records. The retention period for Personal Data may vary depending upon the nature of the information, the services being provided, institutional requirements, and applicable legal obligations. Upon expiry of the applicable retention period, or upon receiving a valid request where deletion is legally permissible, Personal Data shall be securely deleted, anonymised, or archived in accordance with our internal data retention and information security practices. Certain academic records or institutional information may continue to be retained where required by the concerned educational institution or applicable law.

EDDVA is designed for use by schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and other educational institutions and may therefore be used by students who are below the age of eighteen years. Where required under applicable law, the concerned educational institution shall be responsible for obtaining the necessary consent from parents or legal guardians before providing access to the Platform. VVSPL processes the Personal Data of minors solely for legitimate educational purposes authorised by the educational institution and in accordance with applicable legal requirements. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data directly from children outside the educational services provided through authorised institutions. If we become aware that Personal Data has been collected in violation of applicable law, appropriate steps shall be taken to investigate and address the matter.

EDDVA uses cookies and similar technologies to facilitate user authentication, maintain secure sessions, remember user preferences, analyse platform usage, improve performance, enhance security, and provide a better user experience. Cookies may also be used to understand how users interact with the Platform so that we can improve the functionality, accessibility, and performance of our services. Users may configure their browser settings to refuse or delete cookies; however, certain features of EDDVA may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

EDDVA may integrate with trusted third-party service providers for services including cloud hosting, payment processing, email delivery, SMS notifications, video conferencing, push notifications, analytics, customer support, authentication, and other services necessary for operating the Platform. Such third-party service providers process Personal Data only on behalf of VVSPL and only to the extent necessary for providing the relevant services. We require our service providers to implement appropriate security measures and maintain the confidentiality of the information entrusted to them. VVSPL is not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites, applications, or services that are not owned or controlled by us. Users are encouraged to review the privacy policies of such third-party services before providing any Personal Data.

Subject to the provisions of applicable laws, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, users may have the right to request access to their Personal Data, seek correction or updating of inaccurate information, withdraw consent where consent forms the basis of processing, request erasure of Personal Data where legally permissible, and seek redressal of grievances relating to the processing of their Personal Data. Where EDDVA is deployed by an educational institution, requests relating to Personal Data may, where appropriate, be routed through the concerned institution in accordance with applicable contractual arrangements and legal obligations. VVSPL shall endeavour to respond to legitimate requests within a reasonable time and in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

EDDVA primarily stores and processes Personal Data using infrastructure located in accordance with applicable legal and business requirements. Where the use of cloud infrastructure or trusted service providers results in the processing or storage of Personal Data outside India, VVSPL shall ensure that appropriate contractual, organisational, and technical safeguards are implemented in accordance with applicable laws and governmental requirements.

This Privacy Policy shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000, and other applicable laws. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Privacy Policy or the processing of Personal Data through EDDVA shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts at Bhubaneswar, Odisha, unless otherwise required by applicable law.

Where EDDVA is deployed by a school, college, university, coaching institute, or any other educational institution, such institution shall remain responsible for ensuring that the collection and use of Personal Data is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and its internal policies. The institution shall be responsible for maintaining the accuracy of user information, obtaining necessary permissions or consents from students, parents, or legal guardians wherever required, managing user access, and ensuring that the Platform is used solely for legitimate educational purposes. VVSPL provides EDDVA as a technology platform and processes Personal Data only for the purposes of delivering the services subscribed to by the educational institution. Nothing contained in this Privacy Policy shall transfer ownership of institutional records, academic content, or student information from the educational institution to VVSPL.

VVSPL endeavours to maintain accurate and up-to-date Personal Data; however, the accuracy of information depends upon the data provided by users and educational institutions. Users are encouraged to promptly update their Personal Data whenever there is any change to ensure that the information maintained on the Platform remains complete, accurate, and current. Educational institutions are responsible for periodically reviewing and updating academic and administrative records maintained through EDDVA to ensure the reliability of institutional information.

VVSPL recognises the confidential nature of educational information and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality of all Personal Data and Institutional Data processed through EDDVA. Access to such information is restricted to authorised personnel who require access for the purpose of providing, maintaining, supporting, or improving the Platform. All employees, consultants, contractors, service providers, and authorised representatives engaged by VVSPL are subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations and are required to process Personal Data only in accordance with this Privacy Policy, applicable contractual obligations, and relevant laws. Student records, teacher information, institutional documents, academic materials, assessments, reports, videos, learning resources, and other confidential information uploaded to EDDVA shall not be disclosed to unauthorised persons except where required by applicable law or with the authorisation of the concerned educational institution.

VVSPL maintains appropriate procedures for identifying, investigating, responding to, and mitigating security incidents that may affect the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of Personal Data. In the event of a confirmed data breach involving Personal Data, VVSPL shall take reasonable steps to contain the incident, assess its impact, restore the security of the Platform, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence. Where required under applicable law, VVSPL shall notify the affected educational institution and the appropriate regulatory or governmental authorities within the timelines prescribed by law. Users are encouraged to immediately notify VVSPL if they become aware of any suspected unauthorised access, compromise of account credentials, or other security-related incidents involving the Platform.

In the event of a merger, acquisition, corporate restructuring, reorganisation, amalgamation, sale of assets, or any similar business transaction involving VVSPL or EDDVA, Personal Data may be transferred to the successor entity or authorised transferee, subject to the continued protection of such Personal Data in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable laws. Any such transfer shall be undertaken only to the extent necessary for ensuring the continuity of services and shall not adversely affect the rights of users under applicable law.

VVSPL follows the principle of data minimisation and collects only such Personal Data as is reasonably necessary for providing, maintaining, securing, and improving EDDVA and fulfilling applicable legal and contractual obligations. We do not knowingly collect excessive or unnecessary Personal Data, nor do we retain Personal Data for longer than is reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy or as required by applicable law.

VVSPL regularly reviews its privacy, security, and information management practices to ensure continued compliance with applicable laws, recognised industry standards, and evolving technological requirements. As our services continue to evolve, we may adopt additional technical, organisational, and administrative safeguards to further strengthen the protection of Personal Data processed through EDDVA and to align with future regulatory developments relating to privacy, cybersecurity, and Artificial Intelligence.

VVSPL does not use Personal Data belonging to students, parents, teachers, or educational institutions for targeted advertising, behavioural profiling, or commercial exploitation. Where VVSPL communicates information relating to product updates, feature enhancements, training programmes, webinars, or other service-related announcements, such communications shall be limited to legitimate business or educational purposes. Promotional or marketing communications, where applicable, shall be sent in accordance with applicable laws, and recipients may opt out of receiving such communications wherever such option is available.

VVSPL may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in applicable laws, technological developments, industry practices, business operations, or the services offered through EDDVA. The updated version of this Privacy Policy shall be published on the EDDVA website and, where appropriate, notified through the Platform. The "Effective Date" appearing at the beginning of this Privacy Policy shall indicate the date from which the revised version becomes applicable. Users are encouraged to review this Privacy Policy periodically to remain informed about how their Personal Data is protected.

If you have any questions, concerns, requests, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or the manner in which your Personal Data is collected, processed, stored, or protected, you may contact us using the details provided below:

Where required under applicable law, requests relating to access, correction, updating, deletion, withdrawal of consent, or any other rights available under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, may be submitted through the above contact details. We shall endeavour to acknowledge and respond to all legitimate requests within a reasonable timeframe and in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
In accordance with applicable laws, VVSPL has designated a Grievance Officer to address complaints, concerns, and requests relating to the processing of Personal Data through EDDVA.
The Grievance Officer shall endeavour to acknowledge and resolve all privacy-related grievances within the timelines prescribed under applicable law.
